exclusionNote: RF-01 is supplemental reinforcement. It is not part of the 25 Technician instructional labs and is not used to raise any classification.
method: Every official stem was read again. The 23 stems that audit 2 did not mark SUPPORTED were checked against the current close-stage interactions and the February 19, 2026 pool wording. The other stems were checked against lesson evidence that is still present in the current 25 labs. A label, a reference card, or a test name was not treated as instruction. RF-01 was not used.
conceptInventoryNote: 133 concepts. Audit 2 had 132 because it stored elliptical polarization and irregular ionospheric fading as one missing concept and described the fading as a result of the polarization. The pool asks those as different questions, so this inventory splits them.
readiness: READY TO BEGIN TECHNICIAN EXAM READINESS
readinessStatement: The 25 Technician instructional labs teach, practice, and assess the Technician pool's concepts well enough to build the exam-readiness layer. This is not a prediction that any person will pass.

disagreements.previousInterpretation: Audit 2 marked irregular ionospheric fading unsupported and described it as the missing ionospheric polarization mechanism, in the same concept as elliptical polarization.
disagreements.currentInterpretation: T3A08 asks for a likely cause of irregular fading: signals arriving by different paths and combining. T3A09 asks what follows from elliptical polarization: either a vertical or a horizontal antenna can be used. The current TR-05 lab teaches those as separate results.
disagreements.evidence: TR-05 polarization lab fading note and elliptical-polarization sketch; assessment gap-t3a-polarization.
